name: arcgram
description: Surface an AI agent's thinking and make it auditable. Instead of a wall of prose, your agent commits its reasoning to typed nodes and explicit edges — real data you inspect and correct node by node, converging on ground truth that carries across turns, sessions, and agents. Use it as an agent harness or operating frame: propose → draw → self-audit → fix, human in the loop. Delivered as a single standalone interactive HTML file — no build step, no npm, no CDN, no runtime; open in any browser. Ships the Arcgram authoring skill plus the Checkpoint, Reconcile, and Validate self-check skills. Agent-neutral: reads as plain markdown on any framework.
